meta.name: plan-authoring
meta.description: How to write the content of a docs/PLAN.md so a less-capable execution agent implements it without design judgment — structure, precision level, quality checklist, master plans, modular stage files, TinyWasm-specific rules. Use when drafting or reviewing the body of a PLAN.md.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 编写结构清晰的执行计划文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要为执行代理撰写无歧义的设计文档。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write unambiguous design docs for execution agents.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照严格的结构编写或审查 PLAN.md 文件，确保执行代理无需设计判断即可实现。它会添加必需的 frontmatter、列出精确的文件和删除项、包含代码质量清单，并遵循 TinyWasm 特定规则。
howto.when: 当用户要求起草或审查 PLAN.md 文件内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个 PLAN.md，实现一个文件缓存功能。
审查这个 PLAN.md，确保它符合执行代理的要求。
say.note: Claude 会检查结构、精度和完整性。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude writes or reviews PLAN.md files with a strict structure so a less-capable execution agent can implement without design judgment. It adds required frontmatter, lists exact files and deletions, includes a code quality checklist, and follows TinyWasm-specific rules.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to draft or review the content of a PLAN.md file.

say_en.text: Write a PLAN.md to implement a file caching feature.
say_en.note: Claude generates a complete plan with frontmatter, stages, and checklist.

say_en.text: Review this PLAN.md for compliance with execution agent requirements.
say_en.note: Claude checks structure, precision, and completeness.
